verdicts.rationale: All members share DOI 10.1111/phpe.12122, title 'What Is Super Semantics?', author Schlenker, year 2018, Philosophical Perspectives 32(1):365-453. Only archived member (schlenker2018super, depth=none) is field-identical to the survivor. Pure citekey/title-casing variants of one article.

DOI 10.1007/s10988-024-09411-x verified as Schlenker & Lamberton, 'Iconological Semantics', Linguistics and Philosophy 47:779-838 (2024). The archived member sep-sign-language-semantics has a misleading citekey (suggests a SEP article) but its metadata (DOI, title, author, pages) matches the survivor exactly, and it is depth=none, so no deep-indexed folder is lost. Same work.

DOI 10.1515/9783484431003 resolves to Winfried Nöth's Handbuch/Handbook of Semiotics (De Gruyter/Niemeyer). Both members share this DOI and the title 'Handbook of Semiotics'. The archived member noth1995handbook (depth=indexed) has the CORRECT author (Nöth); the survivor sebeok2011handbook has the author wrong (Sebeok was series editor/reviewer, not author). Same book under a mis-attributed survivor. Merge is safe; survivor author field should be corrected to Nöth.

All members share DOI 10.1126/science.171.3972.701, Shepard & Metzler, 'Mental Rotation of Three-Dimensional Objects', Science 171(3972):701-703 (1971). Archived member 1971-Shepard (depth=indexed) is field-identical. Same article.

All members: 'The logical status of diagrams', Shin Sun-Joo, 1994, Cambridge University Press, ISBN 9780521461573. Archived member diagrams1994shin (depth=deepIndexed) shares title, author, year, and ISBN with the survivor. Same book.

verdicts.rationale: All members: 'Writing the book of the world', Theodore Sider, year 2011, ISBN 9780199697908. Archived member sider2011writing (depth=indexed) shares title, author, year, and ISBN. Survivor citekey says 2009 but its fields also say 2011 with the same ISBN. Same book.

Clustering is on the title string alone (no shared DOI/ISBN). The survivor sider2010logic is the 2010 Oxford University Press book (ISBN 9780199575589). The archived member sider2007logic is a 2007 UNPUBLISHED manuscript (type=unpublished, no publisher, no ISBN, year 2007) — the free lecture-notes precursor that Sider revised substantially before the 2010 OUP publication. Different year, different type, no ISBN match: a draft-vs-published-book relationship with substantively different content, and it is depth=indexed (a real folder would be archived). Flagging to avoid archiving on thin (title-only) evidence.

All members: 'Pictorial concepts', Göran Sonesson, 1989, Lund University Press, ISBN 9780862382056. Archived member Sonneson1989pictorial (depth=none) is a citekey typo variant ('Sonneson') with identical title, author, year, and ISBN. Same book.
